name: pizgariu/immutable-test-builder
description: Immutable test data builders for PHP - perfect defaults, clone-based tailoring per test, loud refusal on impossible state and a bundled PHPStan rule set that enforces how a builder must be written. Zero runtime dependencies.

suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Turns the bundled rule set on - include config/extension.neon in your phpstan configuration (^1.12)
suggest.rector/rector: Runs the bundled set - RemoveRedundantModifierRector strips modifiers the kernel derives and maintains the @method tags (^1.2)

scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Measure the kernel and the grammar lookup, reading subjects against each other
scripts-descriptions.benchmark:baseline: Store the current readings on this machine as the reference to compare against
scripts-descriptions.benchmark:check: Re-run against the stored baseline and fail when a subject drifts beyond the tolerance
